{{Quote|Corporal, request our flankers to form up in line and prepare for engagement.|Commander 295.902/V8 during the [[Battle of Sheris]]|<ref name="SWAJ9" />}}
'''295.902/V8''' was the designation of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and held the ranks of [[Major/Legends|Major]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]].

==History==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="atlas200">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> 295.902/V8 was [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. During the [[Thrawn campaign]], he led the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces [[Battle of Sheris|attacking]] the planet [[Sheris]] from his [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]].<ref name="SWAJ9" />
